summary: byNordic Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of a $250,000 unsecured, non-interest-bearing promissory note to Achilles Capital AB, an affiliate of its sponsor. Proceeds are for general working capital, repayable upon consummation of an initial business combination or, if no deal occurs, only from funds outside the trust account. This routine working capital loan does not constitute a special situation transaction.
